answer: Device-bound reward credentials require one certified secure chip per claim budget. Agents identifying quartz, valuing opal or dating a relic prove possession of a chip's non-exportable key; the verifier permits only one budget per chip each epoch. Creating N accounts on one device adds no rewards, while N budgets require buying or renting N devices. This depends on trustworthy manufacturers and proofs that reject cloned keys; compromised attestation issuers defeat the scarcity. It limits cheap aliases, not wealthy device farms.
